name: Craftsmen Training Scheme (CTS) at Industrial Training Institutes (ITIs)
description: Flagship vocational training programme conducted through nationwide ITIs to equip school-passed students (Class 8 or 10) with industry-ready technical trades and National Trade Certificates (NTC).

eligibility_criteria.notes: Minimum age is 14 years with no upper age limit.
Pass in Class 8 or Class 10 depending on chosen trade.

benefits.description: Government-subsidized 1-2 year technical trade training leading to National Trade Certificate (NTC), high industry placement, and state-specific trainee stipends.

application_period.notes: Verified against official guidelines. Window status: upcoming.
